summary: The note describes the Kentish Town rail accident of 2 September 1861 near Kentish Town station in London. An excursion train run by the North London Railway collided with a freight train run by the London and North Western Railway, killing 16 people and injuring 317.
one_line: A 1861 collision near Kentish Town station in London between a North London Railway excursion train and a London and North Western Railway freight train.
key_facts: The Kentish Town rail accident occurred on 2 September 1861.
The accident happened near Kentish Town station in London.
16 people were killed in the Kentish Town rail accident.
317 people were injured in the Kentish Town rail accident.
The accident involved an excursion train operated by the North London Railway.
The excursion train collided with a freight train operated by the London and North Western Railway.
The collision was between a passenger excursion train and a freight train.
